notes: 'Delete originals after conversion' in the Output card of every page (off until you tick it; each page remembers it). Each original goes to the Recycle Bin once its new video is made - only if nothing went wrong for that video and the new file can be read, has a length and a picture. A video that only got an .srt/.csv (or nothing) is kept. If a file can't go to the Recycle Bin (too big, or a drive without one), Windows asks before deleting it for good.
Videos page: the checkbox removes each original after its last action.
Pipelines: new 'Originals' choice per pipeline - keep them, or move them to the Recycle Bin after the last step (watch folders use the pipeline's choice). The steps in between never delete anything.
